reports.PRJ.23026-EL-CAL-5006:
# Transformer & Short-Circuit Calculation — Y-Office Tower — Detailed Design

## 1. Method
IEC 60909 short-circuit (supply + transformer impedance in series). Supply and transformer impedances in series; Isc = U20 / (√3 × Z_total).

## 2. Inputs

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| System voltage U20 | 400 V |
| Utility SC power Psc | 500000 kVA |
| Transformer rating Sn | 1000 kVA |
| Short-circuit voltage Usc | 6 % |
| Copper loss Pcu | 9400 W |

## 3. Results

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Rated current In | 1443.38 A |
| Transformer impedance Z | 9.6 mΩ |
| Total impedance Z_total | 9.92 mΩ |
| **Short-circuit current Isc** | **23.28 kA** |

## 4. Calculation notes

- Transformer loading 87.74% (> 80%) — limited spare capacity.

# Panelboard Schedule — Y-Office Tower — Detailed Design

## 1. Method
Real EL-PBS single-phase convention (classification DF + per-circuit breaker/wire).

## 2. Panel roll-ups

| Panel | Total connected VA | Total demand VA | Demand current A | Min main A | Mains A |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| EPP-SERVICE-8 | 26946.9 | 21802.2 | 31.47 | 32 | 50 |
| EPP-SERVICE-BS-02 | 3966.3 | 3539.7 | 5.11 | 10 | 20 |

## 3. Circuit selection

| Circuit | Type | Current A | Breaker A | Wire mm² |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lighting circuit (small) | LTG | 3.2 | 10 | 2.5 |
| Exit sign / emergency | LTG | 0.5 | 10 | 2.5 |
| Motor feed SP-01 | MTR | 13.0 | 16 | 4 |
| ODU motor 20A | MTR | 18.0 | 20 | 6 |
| ODU motor 30A | MTR | 27.0 | 32 | 10 |
| Socket outlet | S.O | 12.0 | 16 | 4 |
